peg_params — DRIVE pegsim op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.peg_params(r: 'float' = 0.005, R: 'float' = 0.0052, hole_depth: 'float' = 0.02, chamfer: 'float' = 0.001, chamfer_deg: 'float' = 45.0, peg_length: 'float' = 0.04, mu: 'float' = 0.3, n_seg: 'int' = 36, k_trans: 'float' = 600.0, k_rot: 'float' = 1.5, image_size=(640, 480), fovy_deg: 'float' = 40.0) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegsim; pegsim.peg_params(r: 'float' = 0.005, R: 'float' = 0.0052, hole_depth: 'float' = 0.02, chamfer: 'float' = 0.001, chamfer_deg: 'float' = 45.0, peg_length: 'float' = 0.04, mu: 'float' = 0.3, n_seg: 'int' = 36, k_trans: 'float' = 600.0, k_rot: 'float' = 1.5, image_size=(640, 480), fovy_deg: 'float' = 40.0) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("peg_params"))

Usage

Table of peg and hole dimensions: lengths in m, rotational stiffness in N m/rad, camera image in px, and field of view in deg.

Defaults are the prototype dimensions: r = 5.0 mm, R = 5.2 mm (radial clearance 0.2 mm, c = 0.0385), depth 20 mm, 1 mm chamfer at 45°, peg 40 mm, μ = 0.3 (MuJoCo sliding friction). n_seg is the number of boxes approximating the hole wall (MJCF); k_trans [N/m] and k_rot [N m/rad] are the translational and rotational stiffness of the wrist (compliant support); image_size and fovy_deg are for the wrist camera. Raises ValueError: r ≤ 0, R ≤ r, chamfer deeper than the hole, μ < 0, chamfer angle outside (0°, 90°).
